question: Which types of childless or afflicted women are named as recipients of the text's benefit?
premises: Women whose children die are named.
Women with only one child or only daughters are named.
Women who are barren are also named.
inference: The text extends its promised benefit to various categories of women suffering childlessness or loss.
uncertainties: Exact traditional distinctions among these terms may vary.
plain_english: Women who are barren, who lose children, who have only one child, or who have only daughters are included.
